headline: MIA @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 4.92 at PIT 3.59, with a projected total of 8.52. NRFI probability rose +11.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Bryan Reynolds, Heriberto Hernández, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Esmerlyn Valdez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
